category_title: Withdrawn students with receptive language delays who struggle to express feelings
scenario_title: Initial story gathering and emotional expression
minimal_context: Sally is recounting the events of her recent class presentation to her tutor.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Sally, can you tell me what happened when you presented to your class today?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Maintains eye contact) I stood at the front. I held my project. I read it to the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The teacher talked. The students clapped. Then I went back to my desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How did you feel when you were presenting?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Appears withdrawn and self-contained) I read the words. Then it was finished.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Sally, can you tell me what happened when you presented to your class today?

STUDENT: (Maintains eye contact) I stood at the front. I held my project. I read it to the class.

TUTOR: What else happened?

STUDENT: The teacher talked. The students clapped. Then I went back to my desk.

TUTOR: How did you feel when you were presenting?

STUDENT: (Appears withdrawn and self-contained) I read the words. Then it was finished.
